In addition, | taught Eric how to make better selections based on Nutri-
tion Facts labels on food. You, too, can use these labels to guide your
selections. Nutrition Facts labels list the number of grams of carbohydrate,
protein, and fat (and alcohol, if present) per serving. To convert grams into
calories, use this information:

1 gram carbohydrate = 4 calories
1 gram protein = 4 calories
1 gram fat = 9 calories
1 gram alcohol = 7 calories
